_comment: Extra CurseForge/Modrinth slugs to resolve directly when provider text
search misses a well-known pack. Consulted by candidateSlugs()
(utility/modpack/search.js) and merged into the ranked hit list.
Keys are normalized queries (lowercase, punctuation collapsed to spaces —
see normalizeSearchText). Values are provider slugs tried on both providers.
Each alias costs two upstream requests per keystroke that matches it, and
candidateSlugs caps the total tried per query (MAX_CANDIDATE_SLUGS), so
aliases are for packs the providers genuinely fail to return by name — not
a general-purpose ranking fix. Reach for the scoring in scoreHit() first.
